answer: A concrete sybil defense: every attestation refracts through a prism of independent checkpoints run by different operators, so no single party can forge a complete proof. Weight is capped by how many distinct violet-shaded quorums an identity satisfies, and clones funded from one source fail because their quorums overlap. The system also flags an ember pattern: accounts that ignite together and act in lockstep get down-weighted. Attacking means recruiting many unrelated real validators per fake identity and sustaining them across epochs, paying full cost while reward stays capped.
